description:
Go to http://DrinkLMNT.com/coolworlds for a free sample pack with any purchase!

There's been a lot of news about a possible detection of a dark matter particle - did we finally just crack one of the grandest challenges in modern science?! Today, we break down what dark matter is, how the search experiment works, and what was found.

Written by Kaliroe Pappas & David Kipping. Presented & edited by David Kipping.
